By the Order No. 332 of 2014 dated 17.11.2014 made under theProviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460)and published in the Gazette Extra Ordinary No. 1889/37 dated21.11.2014, the land specified morefully in the Schedule below wasvested in the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka.

But the possession of the said land has not yet been taken for andon behalf of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. Therefore,I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, by virtue of powers vested in me under section 39 (1) ofthe Land Acquisition Act, do hereby revoke the Order made in respectof the land sepcified morefully under the aforesaid Order No. 332 of2014 dated 17.11.2014 published in the Gazette Extra OrdinaryNo. 1889/37 dated 21.11.2014.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.

My No.: 4/3/12/2014/UDA/110.Divisional Secretary’s No.: CO/DS/ACQ/3/85/UDA.Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,“Mihikatha Medura”, Land Secretariat,No. 1200/06,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.25th October, 2018.
